title: Do Oversight Protocols Help Where Humans Are Most Likely to Err?

original_idea.body:
# Do Oversight Protocols Help Where Humans Are Most Likely to Err?

**Problem:** It is unknown whether debate/consultancy add the most value precisely on the subtle-flaw items where unaided weak judges fail.

**Direction:** Bucket annotated-error items (FindTheFlaws) by flaw subtlety. For each bucket measure unaided weak-judge accuracy vs debate-assisted vs consultancy-assisted. Test whether protocols' marginal benefit concentrates on subtle flaws.

**Why it matters:** Oversight protocols are only worth their cost if they help where naive oversight fails.

**Relevant context:** arXiv:2503.22989; Kenton et al. (2024); arXiv:2504.03731.
